rows.information: Tata Institute of Social Sciences, Mumbai

content_sections.heading: About TISS
content_sections.text: The Tata Institute of Social Sciences is on V.N. Purav Marg, Deonar, Mumbai 400 088. The notice describes it as a Deemed to be University under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956, and a grant-in-aid Institute under the Ministry of Education, Government of India. This post is with the Centre for Lifelong Learning in the School of Social Work, and it serves the TISS–Parzor Certificate Programme.

content_sections.heading: TISS Programme Manager (Part-time) Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: You will coordinate admissions, keep the database of enrolled students and work with the TISS Academic Section so that admissions are processed and results declared on time. The notice lists these duties: Coordinate the admissions process, including updating the admission portal, reviewing applications, scheduling interviews and communicating with applicants. Guide and support prospective students through the application process and answer their questions and concerns in good time. Work with the relevant departments so that admission requirements and deadlines are met. Keep accurate records of applicant data and admissions statistics for reporting. Help develop and carry out marketing materials and outreach to promote the certificate programme. Liaise with the TISS academic section on admissions, fee collection and grade reporting. content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are screened and a shortlist is made. Shortlisted candidates hear by 12 November 2026, by email or telephone. Online interviews for final selection take place from 15 to 17 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TISS Programme Manager (Part-time) Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare your resume. Write a cover letter that sets out the qualifications and experience you have for this role. Email both to [email protected] no later than 10 November 2026. Watch your email and phone for a call to the interview. Only shortlisted candidates are contacted. Documents to send: your resume and a cover letter.

faq.question: Q1. Which programme is this post for?
faq.answer: It is for the TISS–Parzor Certificate Programme, run by the Centre for Lifelong Learning in the TISS School of Social Work, Mumbai.

faq.question: Q2. Is this a full-time job?
faq.answer: No. It is a part-time contract post of about 20 hours per week.

faq.question: Q3. How long is the contract?
faq.answer: It runs for 06 months to begin with. It may be extended up to 1 year, depending on your performance and what the project needs.

faq.question: Q4. Can graduates of any subject apply?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice asks for a Bachelor's degree in any field.

faq.question: Q5. Do I need experience?
faq.answer: Experience is not mandatory. Previous work in admissions or student services is preferred, and familiarity with TISS systems and processes is highly desirable.

faq.question: Q6. What do I send with my application?
faq.answer: Send a resume and a cover letter that describe your qualifications and experience for the role. Both go to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. When will I know if I am shortlisted?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be told by 12 November 2026, by email or telephone. Only shortlisted candidates are contacted.

faq.question: Q8. Will the interview be in person?
faq.answer: No. The final interviews are online, between 15 and 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job based?
faq.answer: At the Centre for Lifelong Learning, School of Social Work, TISS, V.N. Purav Marg, Deonar, Mumbai 400 088.
